title: Valve trombone, slide trombone and brass band playing
summary: He played valve trombone when learning in Reserve but never in a band, played some slide trombone at home, and played trumpet in brass bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: One about, did you play valve trombone one time?
Yeah, I played it. When I first, when I first, when I first started playing, learning that play, I was learning that play. It was reserve. Yeah, reserve.
Did you ever play it in the jazz band, though?
If the valve trombone in the band?
No, no, I never played in the band with it. I never played in the band with it.
Did you play anything else except the trumpet and the valve trombone?
Well, I like to play slide and trombone, something, I used to play a little of that too.
Never played in the brass band or anything?

No, no, I never, I played in brass band, sure. I mean in the slide. No, no, never played no trombone or brass band. Just around home. Just trumpet, you see? Yeah. Yeah, I played trumpet in brass bands, just like that, you know what I mean?
